name: Circadian Entrainment and Non-Visual Light Effects
mechanism_chain_provenance: NEWLY ESTABLISHED in LIGHT-I — no prior structural template in Document 34; calibrated from gap stub

mechanism_chain.description: Corneal melanopic irradiance (m-EDI) above alerting threshold (≥30 m-lux)

data.finding: Light activates brainstem arousal centers with threshold approximately 10-50 m-lux depending on circadian phase
data.source: Cajochen et al. (2000); Vandewalle et al. (2006)
data.paradigm: Controlled light exposure with EEG and fMRI
data.effect: Acute alertness increase; brainstem BOLD activation

justification.backing: The alerting threshold is lower than the circadian entrainment threshold because M2-M4 ipRGCs have different projection targets and sensitivities than M1 cells.
justification.qualifier: Threshold varies with circadian phase and prior sleep.
justification.rebuttal: Would fail if the alerting response is visual-cortical rather than brainstem-mediated.

mechanism_chain.description: → M2–M4 ipRGC projections: (a) olivary pretectal nucleus → pupillary constriction; (b) intergeniculate leaflet → NPY/GABA → SCN phase modulation; (c) dorsal raphe nucleus → serotonergic arousal; (d) locus coeruleus → NE release → prefrontal cortical arousal

data.finding: M2-M4 ipRGC subtypes project to OPN, IGL, DRN, and LC; distinct from M1 SCN projections

justification.backing: Foster's subtype distinction is critical: alerting operates via M2-M4 projections, not the M1 circadian pathway.
justification.qualifier: Established in animal models; human homology presumed.
justification.rebuttal: Would fail if human ipRGC subtypes differ substantially.

mechanism_chain.description: → LC-NE: diffuse cortical NE elevation → increased gain of sensory processing → heightened alertness + reduced drowsiness

data.finding: Light exposure activates LC-NE system; diffuse cortical NE increases sensory processing gain
data.effect: BOLD increase in LC region and prefrontal cortex

justification.backing: The LC-NE arousal system is a well-characterized neuromodulatory pathway; light is an established input.
justification.qualifier: fMRI localizes to LC region but does not directly measure NE release.
justification.rebuttal: Would fail if the fMRI activation reflects a different brainstem structure.

mechanism_chain.description: → Histaminergic tuberomammillary nucleus (TMN): light-driven histamine release → wakefulness support

data.finding: TMN histaminergic neurons receive indirect light input and contribute to wakefulness

justification.backing: The histaminergic wakefulness system is established; light-driven activation is plausible via brainstem pathways.
justification.qualifier: Less direct evidence for light-TMN pathway than for light-LC pathway.
justification.rebuttal: Would fail if histamine contribution is negligible relative to NE.

mechanism_chain.description: → Simultaneously: M1 SCN entrainment pathway (CIRCADIAN_ARCH_REG_001) operating in parallel

data.finding: M1 ipRGCs project to SCN; operates in parallel with M2-M4 alerting pathways

justification.backing: The circadian and alerting pathways operate independently but simultaneously. This is the dual-pathway model.
justification.qualifier: Cross-reference to L2 (CIRCADIAN_ARCH_REG_001) for detailed circadian pathway.
justification.rebuttal: Would fail if pathways interact in ways that make them non-additive.

mechanism_chain.description: → Net behavioral output: acute alertness increase (latency ~5–15 min), sustained across exposure duration, additive with caffeine and social engagement but independent of them

data.finding: Each doubling of melanopic lux above threshold adds d=0.22 to sustained attention performance during afternoon alertness trough
data.source: Vandewalle et al. (2006); de Kort & Veitch (2014)

justification.backing: The alertness benefit is empirically demonstrated but effect sizes are modest (d ≈ 0.22).
justification.qualifier: Effect size may vary with individual differences, circadian phase, and prior sleep.
justification.rebuttal: Would fail if the effect is confounded with novelty or arousal from any stimulus change.

noradrenergic_response.note: Each doubling of melanopic lux above alerting threshold adds approximately d=0.22 to sustained attention task performance during the biological afternoon (13:00–16:00) — the circadian alertness trough
noradrenergic_response.source: Vandewalle et al. (2006); de Kort & Veitch (2014) review synthesis

elderly.note: Reduced LC-NE responsiveness with aging; larger architectural dose required for equivalent alerting

chronotype_extreme_evening.timing_note: Alerting benefit shifted ~2h later in biological time for extreme evening chronotypes

luminance_level.note: The NM alerting response is driven by melanopic irradiance at the retina, not by perceived brightness. A warm 2700K source at 500 photopic lux delivers approximately 155 m-lux mEDI; a cool 6500K source at 300 photopic lux delivers approximately 270 m-lux mEDI. The 6500K source is dimmer to the visual system but more alerting via the NM pathway. This dissociation has direct architectural implications: perceived brightness (visual comfort) and alerting efficacy are separable design targets.

ie_dpt_interaction: T_IE_004 (Real-Time Activity Frame Shift) — light-driven alertness elevation can shift the occupant from a low-engagement implicit processing mode to an active directed-attention mode, functioning as an environmental frame-shift trigger
